email.subject: Mumbai is slow — is it us or AWS?
email.body:
Payments latency is up in Mumbai.

WHAT HAPPENED
The app feels slow. We do not know yet if AWS has a regional problem or if it is our code.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open AWS Health on the console home.
2. Check Mumbai (ap-south-1) for an AWS event.
3. Read the operational status before you blame Finova.

DO NOT
Do not restart instances or change the VPC.

REPLY WITH
What Health showed, and whether we should keep investigating the Finova app or wait on AWS.

— Meera

steps.instruction: Check AWS Health / status for ap-south-1 (or note no open AWS event in sim).
Decide: escalate to app team vs wait on AWS event.

reply.model_reply: Checked AWS Health for ap-south-1 — no blocking regional event in sim. Recommend continue Finova app triage while monitoring Health. — L1

debrief.english: Rule out AWS-side before blaming the app.
debrief.tanglish: AWS Health paathutu app blame pannunga.
